title: Jacobi algebras and Jacobi Novikov-Poisson algebras
summary: In this paper, we introduce the notion of Jacobi Novikov-Poisson algebras and demonstrate that their affinization yields Jacobi algebras. We note that every unital differential Novikov-Poisson algebra is also a Jacobi Novikov-Poisson algebra. Additionally, any Jacobi Novikov-Poisson algebra gives rise to a Jacobi algebra, either by taking the commutator bracket of its underlying Novikov algebra or by using a derivation.
